overall.decision: Reject revised semantic prompt; do not adopt candidates-only on unproven quality gains.
overall.assessment: Same-budget interpretation changes did not produce a clear retrieval-quality gain. Revised semantic wording gates away the long-tense lexical path and shifts indirect-narrator results without direct lying-storyteller support. Candidate-generation-only wording largely preserves results; its getaway reorder is a plausible tie/tradeoff, not a clear win against directly supported existing titles. Token/cost budget compliance does not establish quality.
overall.cost: 39 new experimental attribute calls cost $0.006069252 total, separate from historical experiment spending. Runtime retains two model calls with shared frozen fingerprint capture; per-arm actual interpreted model cost shown separately.
overall.timing: Native paired SQL screens are single measurements, unsuitable for declaring a latency winner.
